title: Randomized to polynomial-size circuits
statement: Let $E$ be a verifier model and let $L$ be a language of bit strings. If $E$ is closed under majority, $L$ has an efficient verifier with two-thirds acceptance probability on members and two-thirds rejection probability on nonmembers, and every efficient verifier using polynomially many random bits has circuits of polynomial size computing its verification predicate, then $L$ is decidable by a family of fan-in-two circuits of polynomial size.
hypotheses_covered: Every efficient verifier has polynomial-size fan-in-two circuits for each polynomial random-bit bound
